name: How do I compare HH Remodeling with other contractors without getting burned?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare HH Remodeling with other contractors without getting burned?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing remodelers in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, compare scope clarity, experience with your type of project, and how they handle unknown conditions. The cheapest bid is not always the best if it leaves out repair work, cleanup, or finish details that matter later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare scope, experience, and how each contractor handles hidden conditions. A low bid can be misleading if it leaves out important work.
